corpus: mixed human/model final documents from earlier sessions
finding: No useful primary personal advantage is established. Both interval methods exclude the useful margin against base, pooled, donor and uniform; all primary intervals include zero. Adapted-minus-base donor, pooled and uniform useful advantages remain unresolved under both methods, with all intervals including zero. The residual uniform writer lower endpoint crosses the useful margin only narrowly at full precision. Raw sums exclude useful base and donor advantage under both methods, exclude useful pooled advantage under writer resampling but leave it unresolved under crossed resampling, and are worse than uniform under both methods. All raw model-rival intervals include zero. No parity follows.
limits: Mixed human/model training prose, sparse histories, overlapping or expanded human units, fixed donor/global training and exposed prompts bound the tested recipe. No independent human confirmation, seed or corpus ranking, population limit, private-goal inference or whole-matrix verdict. Earlier failed/unknown attempts remain separate; no new retry.
